author: Lintuxer
tagline: Encrypted, deduplicated backup of your ZimaOS data — to disk or to the cloud
description:
Kopia backs up your files with client-side encryption, deduplication and compression. Nothing leaves this machine unencrypted, and identical data is stored once no matter how often it repeats across snapshots. The repository can live on a local disk, on S3, Backblaze B2, Google Cloud, Azure, an SFTP or WebDAV server, or anything rclone reaches — all from the same web UI.

**Set three variables before you install** — open "Advanced (show more)": `KOPIA_SERVER_USERNAME` and `KOPIA_SERVER_PASSWORD` are the web UI login, and `KOPIA_PASSWORD` is the repository password that encrypts the backups. **If you lose the repository password, the backups cannot be read — there is no reset.** While these are empty the UI answers every request with 401, so an install without them is locked, not exposed.

This package mounts all of /DATA read-only, so Kopia can read everything it backs up and cannot change any of it. If you snapshot /data as a whole, exclude /data/AppData/kopia — otherwise the repository backs itself up.

tips.before_install:
**SET THREE VARIABLES BEFORE YOU INSTALL** — open "Advanced (show more)" and fill them in. While they are empty this app answers every request with 401: it is locked, not open, and no password will get you in.

- `KOPIA_SERVER_USERNAME` — the name you log into the web UI with.
- `KOPIA_SERVER_PASSWORD` — the password for that login. It guards a tool that can read every file under /DATA.
- `KOPIA_PASSWORD` — the repository password. **This one encrypts your backups. If you lose it the backups cannot be read, and there is no reset.** Put it in a password manager before you press install.

Two more things. All of /DATA is mounted **read-only** at `/data`, so Kopia can read everything it backs up and change none of it. And if you snapshot `/data` as a whole, exclude `/data/AppData/kopia` — the repository is visible through that mount too, and a repository that backs itself up never stops growing.
